MatriComDB Matrisome Pair Database

Source: R/zzz.R
matrisome_pairs.Rd

Database of unique heterotypic MatriComDB pairs for spatial co-expression analysis. Every pair contains at least one matrisome gene. The source data span multiple MatriComDB interaction classes, including annotated ECM communication records and structural ECM interactions. A row should not be interpreted as signaling unless its annotation supports that interpretation.

Usage

matrisome_pairs

Format

A data frame with columns:

Gene1

First pair-member gene symbol

Gene2

Second pair-member gene symbol

Source

Database source for the interaction

Interaction_Type

Type of interaction

Database_Score

Confidence score from source database

Details

Reciprocal records are collapsed to one alphabetically ordered pair and homomeric records are excluded.

Examples

data(matrisome_pairs)
head(matrisome_pairs)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   Gene1         Gene2 Interaction_Type Source            Database_Score
#>   <chr>         <chr> <chr>            <chr>                      <dbl>
#> 1 1810065E05RIK VTN   Cell-Matrix      STRING_physical                1
#> 2 2210010C04RIK AMBP  Cell-Matrix      STRING_physical                1
#> 3 4933400A11RIK S100B Cell-Matrix      STRING_physical                1
#> 4 A             PLG   Cell-Matrix      STRING_physical                1
#> 5 A1BG          FGB   Cell-Matrix      STRING_physical                1
#> 6 A2M           ANXA7 Matrix-Matrix    MatrixDB IMEx ext              1
nrow(matrisome_pairs)
#> [1] 16876
